description: This file implements a logging utility for Android-based systems, providing functions to convert severity levels, generate log messages with headers, and manage logging destinations such as files and stderr. It defines the TeeLogger class for multi-destination logging and includes functions to create loggers that write to files or both stderr and files.

classes.name: TeeLogger
classes.description: A logger class that outputs log messages to multiple destinations such as files and stderr, with configurable metadata levels.

methods.name: FromSeverity
methods.description: Converts a LogSeverity enum to its string representation.

methods.name: ToSeverity
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the corresponding LogSeverity enum value.

methods.name: ConsoleSeverity
methods.description: Retrieves the severity level for console logging based on environment variables.

methods.name: LogFileSeverity
methods.description: Retrieves the severity level for file logging based on environment variables.

methods.name: LogToFiles
methods.description: Creates a TeeLogger that writes logs to specified files with a given prefix.

methods.name: LogToStderrAndFiles
methods.description: Creates a TeeLogger that writes logs to both stderr and specified files with a given prefix and metadata level.
